nodes.description: uint8 public gType = 2, game type identifier used when reporting winners to the stats aggregator.
uint8 public fee = 10, percentage commission taken from the game jackpot.
uint public game, current game number, set from block.number in startGame.
uint public ticketPrice = 0.01 ether, exact ETH amount required to buy a ticket.
uint public newPrice, pending ticket price applied on the next game start.
uint public allTimeJackpot, cumulative amount paid out to winners.
uint public allTimePlayers, cumulative count of players.
uint public paidToPartners, running total of amounts already paid to referral partners.
bool public isActive, game acceptance status checked by buyTicket and startGame.
bool public toogleStatus, pending request to switch game status on the next start.
uint[] public games, array of all game numbers.
mapping(uint => uint) jackpot, per-game accumulated ETH jackpot.
mapping(uint => address[]) players, per-game list of participant addresses.
iOwnable public ownable, external ownership/whitelist contract consulted by the onlyOwner modifier.
iCryptolottoStatsAggregator public stats, external stats aggregator notified on each winner.
iCryptolottoReferral public referralInstance, external referral system contract queried and written to.
address public fundsDistributor, recipient of the commission via a low-level call.
msg.sender, attacker controllable address pushed into players and checked by the owner modifier.
block.timestamp (now), miner-influenced value used both for events and for winner randomness.
address(fundsDistributor).call.gas(30000).value(distribute)() - unchecked low-level value call with revert on failure.
players[game][winner].transfer(toPlayer) - ETH push to an arbitrary winning participant.
partner.transfer(sum) - ETH push to an arbitrary referral partner address.
salesPartner.transfer(sum) - ETH push to an arbitrary sales partner address.
referralInstance.addReferral(partner, referral) - state-changing external call into the referral contract.
stats.newWinner(...) - external call to the stats aggregator after payout bookkeeping.
keccak256 of time, difficulty, block number and block hash - miner-influenceable pseudo randomness.
jackpot[game] * fee / 100 - unchecked uint arithmetic used to split the jackpot.
ticketPrice * fee / 100 and distribute * percent / 100 - unchecked uint arithmetic in referral payout.
Cryptolotto1Hour constructor, wires ownable/stats/referral/distributor and starts the first game.
function() public payable fallback that forwards the call to buyTicket(address(0)).
getPlayedGamePlayers() view returning the number of players of the current game.
getPlayersInGame(uint playedGame) view returning players[playedGame].length.
getPlayedGameJackpot() view returning the jackpot of the current game.
getGameJackpot(uint playedGame) view returning jackpot[playedGame].
toogleActive() onlyOwner, immediately activates or queues a status switch via toogleStatus.
start() onlyOwner, picks the winner of the finished game and starts the next one.
changeTicketPrice(uint price) onlyOwner, stores a pending price in newPrice.
randomNumber(...) pure, derives a pseudo random index from miner controllable block values.
buyTicket(address partner) payable, validates price/status, credits jackpot, registers the player and processes referrals.
startGame() internal, sets game from block.number and applies pending price/status changes.
pickTheWinner() internal, chooses the winner, splits the jackpot and performs all payouts and stats reporting.
processReferralSystem(address partner, address referral) internal, registers referrals and pays partners.
transferToPartner(address referral) internal, pays a partner and cascades to sales partner payout.
transferToSalesPartner(address partner) internal, pays the sales partner of a partner.
getPartnerAmount(address partner) internal view, converts a partner percent into an ETH amount.
getSalesPartnerAmount(address partner) internal view, converts a sales percent into an ETH amount.
calculateReferral(uint8 percent) internal view, computes the referral share of the ticket commission.
onlyOwner modifier, requires ownable.allowed(msg.sender) before executing the guarded body.
ownableContract constructor parameter cast into the iOwnable instance.
distributor constructor parameter assigned to fundsDistributor.
statsA constructor parameter cast into the iCryptolottoStatsAggregator instance.
referralSystem constructor parameter cast into the iCryptolottoReferral instance.
playedGame parameter of getPlayersInGame used to index the players mapping.
playedGame parameter of getGameJackpot used to index the jackpot mapping.
price parameter of changeTicketPrice stored into newPrice.
min parameter of randomNumber, lower bound of the returned index.
max parameter of randomNumber, upper bound of the returned index.
time parameter of randomNumber, multiplied into the keccak256 seed (block.timestamp at call site).
difficulty parameter of randomNumber, multiplied into the keccak256 seed.
number parameter of randomNumber, multiplied into the keccak256 seed (block.number at call site).
bHash parameter of randomNumber, block hash cast into the keccak256 seed.
partner parameter of buyTicket forwarded to processReferralSystem.
partner parameter of processReferralSystem registered via addReferral.
referral parameter of processReferralSystem used to look up the partner.
referral parameter of transferToPartner used to resolve the paying partner.
partner parameter of transferToSalesPartner used to resolve the sales partner.
partner parameter of getPartnerAmount used to query the partner percent.
partner parameter of getSalesPartnerAmount used to query the sales partner percent.
percent parameter of calculateReferral, the share applied to the ticket commission.
local uint random in randomNumber, first keccak256 derived value modulo 10 plus 1.
local uint result in randomNumber, clamped into [min, max] and decremented before return.
local uint playerNumber in buyTicket, the zero-based ticket number of the buyer.
local uint winner in pickTheWinner, index of the selected player.
local uint toPlayer in pickTheWinner, net amount transferred to the winner.
local uint distribute in pickTheWinner, commission split between partners and the distributor.
local bool result in pickTheWinner, success flag of the low-level distributor call.
local address partnerRef in processReferralSystem, cached partner lookup result.
local address partner in transferToPartner, resolved referral partner.
local uint sum in transferToPartner, amount transferred to the partner.
local address salesPartner in transferToSalesPartner, resolved sales partner.
local uint sum in transferToSalesPartner, amount transferred to the sales partner.
local uint8 partnerPercent in getPartnerAmount returned by the referral contract.
local uint8 salesPartnerPercent in getSalesPartnerAmount returned by the referral contract.
local uint distribute in calculateReferral, ticket commission base for the percent split.

edges.reason: ticketPrice is read by buyTicket to enforce msg.value == ticketPrice.
isActive is read by buyTicket to gate ticket purchases.
jackpot[game] is credited with msg.value inside buyTicket.
players[game] is appended with msg.sender inside buyTicket.
the partner parameter of buyTicket controls the referral path.
msg.sender is pushed into players[game] and emitted in the Ticket event.
game is reassigned from block.number in startGame.
newPrice is consumed and reset by startGame.
ticketPrice is overwritten with the pending newPrice in startGame.
toogleStatus is checked and cleared by startGame.
isActive is required and possibly flipped by startGame.
game selects the players/jackpot entries handled by pickTheWinner.
players[game] provides the winner set and count in pickTheWinner.
jackpot[game] is the pool distributed by pickTheWinner.
fee is the commission percentage applied by pickTheWinner.
paidToPartners is subtracted from the commission and later reset in pickTheWinner.
fundsDistributor is the target of the low-level value call in pickTheWinner.
allTimeJackpot is incremented in pickTheWinner.
allTimePlayers is incremented in pickTheWinner.
gType is passed to stats.newWinner in pickTheWinner.
getPlayedGamePlayers reads the current game index.
getPlayersInGame reads players[playedGame].length.
getPlayedGameJackpot reads the current game index.
getGameJackpot reads jackpot[playedGame].
referralInstance is queried/written by processReferralSystem.
players[game].length decides whether partners are paid in processReferralSystem.
referralInstance.getPartnerByReferral is called by transferToPartner.
paidToPartners accumulates the partner sum in transferToPartner.
referralInstance.getSalesPartner is called by transferToSalesPartner.
paidToPartners accumulates the sales partner sum in transferToSalesPartner.
ticketPrice is the base of the commission in calculateReferral.
fee is the commission percentage in calculateReferral.
the onlyOwner modifier delegates the authorization decision to ownable.allowed.
msg.sender is the value checked against ownable.allowed in onlyOwner.
playedGame indexes the players mapping in getPlayersInGame.
playedGame indexes the jackpot mapping in getGameJackpot.
price is written into newPrice by changeTicketPrice.
min bounds the random index in randomNumber.
max bounds the random index in randomNumber.
the caller supplied time value feeds the weak randomness seed in randomNumber.
difficulty feeds the randomness seed in randomNumber.
number feeds the randomness seed in randomNumber.
bHash feeds the randomness seed in randomNumber.
partner is forwarded into addReferral by processReferralSystem.
referral is used for the partner lookup in processReferralSystem.
referral resolves the paying partner in transferToPartner.
partner resolves the sales partner in transferToSalesPartner.
partner is queried for its percent in getPartnerAmount.
partner is queried for its sales percent in getSalesPartnerAmount.
percent scales the commission in calculateReferral.
ownableContract is cast into the iOwnable instance by the constructor.
distributor is assigned to fundsDistributor by the constructor.
statsA is cast into the stats aggregator instance by the constructor.
referralSystem is cast into the referral instance by the constructor.
block.timestamp is the miner-influenced entropy source passed into randomNumber.
block.timestamp is used as the randomness input when pickTheWinner calls randomNumber.
jackpot[game] is an operand of the unchecked jackpot * fee / 100 computation.
fee is an operand of the unchecked jackpot * fee / 100 computation.
ticketPrice is an operand of the unchecked ticketPrice * fee / 100 computation.
fee is an operand of the unchecked referral payout computations.
randomNumber produces the predictable keccak256 based randomness.
the constructor calls startGame to initialise the first game.
the fallback function forwards plain ETH transfers to buyTicket.
toogleActive may set isActive back to true.
changeTicketPrice writes the pending price into newPrice.
start calls pickTheWinner when the previous game had players.
start always calls startGame after settling the previous game.
buyTicket invokes processReferralSystem for the buyer.
pickTheWinner calls randomNumber to select the winner.
pickTheWinner pays the winner's partner through transferToPartner.
transferToPartner cascades into transferToSalesPartner.
transferToPartner computes the sum via getPartnerAmount.
transferToSalesPartner computes the sum via getSalesPartnerAmount.
getPartnerAmount delegates the amount math to calculateReferral.
getSalesPartnerAmount delegates the amount math to calculateReferral.
getPlayedGamePlayers calls getPlayersInGame for the current game.
getPlayedGameJackpot calls getGameJackpot for the current game.
onlyOwner guards toogleActive.
onlyOwner guards start.
onlyOwner guards changeTicketPrice.
pickTheWinner makes an external call into the stats aggregator before completing bookkeeping.
pickTheWinner forwards ETH to fundsDistributor through an unchecked low-level call with a 30000 gas stipend.
pickTheWinner pushes ETH to the winning player, an attacker controlled address.
transferToPartner pushes ETH to an arbitrary partner address.
transferToSalesPartner pushes ETH to an arbitrary sales partner address.
processReferralSystem performs the state changing external call addReferral on the referral contract.

distributor is only used to set fundsDistributor inside the constructor.
statsA is only used to build the stats aggregator instance inside the constructor.
referralSystem is only used to build the referral instance inside the constructor.
playedGame is the read key of getPlayersInGame.
playedGame is the read key of getGameJackpot.
price flows directly into newPrice inside changeTicketPrice.
min is a bound used only inside randomNumber.
max is a bound used only inside randomNumber.
time is a randomness seed component inside randomNumber.
difficulty is a randomness seed component inside randomNumber.
number is a randomness seed component inside randomNumber.
bHash is a randomness seed component inside randomNumber.
partner is forwarded by buyTicket into the referral flow.
partner is registered through addReferral in processReferralSystem.
referral is the lookup key of processReferralSystem.
referral is the lookup key of transferToPartner.
partner is the lookup key of transferToSalesPartner.
partner is the query key of getPartnerAmount.
partner is the query key of getSalesPartnerAmount.
percent is the scaling factor used by calculateReferral.
random is a scratch value internal to randomNumber.
result is the clamped return value internal to randomNumber.
playerNumber is a scratch index computed inside buyTicket.
winner is the intermediate index computed inside pickTheWinner.
toPlayer is the intermediate payout amount computed inside pickTheWinner.
distribute is the commission scratch variable inside pickTheWinner.

salesPartner is the recipient of the ETH transfer in transferToSalesPartner.
sum is the amount transferred to the sales partner.

salesPartnerPercent is the referral contract return value used by getSalesPartnerAmount.
